title: Trading coach
subtitle: Ask anything about the chart in front of you. The coach answers from facts the engine already calculated.

mode.label: Answer mode
mode.coachHint: Asks you questions first, so you do the thinking.
mode.directHint: Gives the answer straight, no questions back.

chat.empty: No conversation yet. Start with one of the questions below.
chat.noContext: No market selected. Pick one so the coach reads a real chart.
chat.sourceLlm: Answered by the language model, using engine numbers.
chat.sourceDeterministic: Answered directly from the engine (no language model key configured).

suggest.label: Common questions
suggest.why: What is this market doing right now?
suggest.wait: Why should I not enter yet?
suggest.stop: Why does the stop belong there?
suggest.mtf: Do the higher and lower timeframes conflict?

teach.title: Teach me this setup
teach.subtitle: Uses the chart in front of you as the example, not abstract theory.
teach.whatToSee: What to look at on this chart
teach.howToFind: How to find this setup yourself

whatIf.title: What if?
whatIf.subtitle: Pose a scenario and see whether the read changes.
whatIf.placeholder: e.g. what if price breaks below the zone and reclaims it on the next candle?
whatIf.note: This is a simulation, not a prediction.

grade.title: Grade my analysis
grade.subtitle: Write your own read of this chart, then compare it with what the engine sees.
grade.placeholder: I see an uptrend pulling back into demand, waiting for a confirmation candle before entry...

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.subtitle: Technical terms stay in English, with a plain explanation attached.

memory.title: What the coach remembers about you
memory.subtitle: Built only from your own journal. Nothing is assumed.
memory.empty: Not enough data yet. Log a few more trades and patterns will start to show.

psychology.title: Psychology coach
psychology.subtitle: Based on recorded behaviour, not personality judgements.
psychology.noPatterns: No patterns with clear evidence yet, which is a good sign.

aiPerf.title: AI performance
aiPerf.subtitle: Transparency on how well the analysis has held up, broken down by setup grade.
aiPerf.notEnough: Too few samples to conclude anything.
